$comment: The one list of stable element ids for the sample apps' e2e flows (e2e/maestro). Add ids; never rename or remove one. See README.md next to this file.

sw.feed.list.description: The app's container around the platform's native feed component.

sw.feed.status.description: One line of feed status (loading, loaded, error).

sw.feed.ad.description: One ad row inside the SDK feed.

sw.listing.card.description: One listing card. The app sets it on its own cards (Listings). The SDK feed sets it on each listing row (Feed).

sw.ad.banner.size.description: The banner slot's measured size in points or dp.

sw.ad.house.description: The house ad slot, where the platform has a public house ad.

missingOn.ios: No public house ad view. House backfill runs inside SellwildAdView on a no-fill.
missingOn.android: SellwildHouseAdView is internal. House backfill runs inside SellwildAdView on a no-fill.

sw.ad.house.size.description: The house ad slot's measured size.

sw.listings.list.description: The app's list of listing cards.

sw.listings.refresh.description: Refresh: clears the listings cache and fetches again.

sw.listings.status.description: Load status. After a good load: '<count> listings, load <n>', where n counts loads this launch.

sw.diag.failures.description: Failure codes seen this launch, or 'not available on this platform' where the SDK has no public failure sink.

sw.diag.failure_context.description: The public failure context (partner, reporting on or off, sample rate, client), where the platform has one.

sw.legacy.status.description: One line of widget status (loading, loaded, error).

sw.legacy.webview.description: The container of the deprecated WebView widget. Flows assert the container only.
